# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Note the date of the failed inspection.
3. Record the specific address of the building.
4. List the name of the fire safety inspector.
5. Identify and describe the category of violations.
6. Detail the specific items or areas that failed inspection.
7. Specify whether the failure is due to a lack of equipment, improper installation, maintenance issues, or non-compliance with code standards.
8. Note the severity of the violations (low, medium, high risk).
9. Include any relevant photographic or video evidence.
10. Record any verbal discussions or reports with building managers or owners.
11. Outline the necessary corrective actions needed.
12. State any consequences or notices issued (e.g., warnings, fines, shutdowns).
13. Recommend a date for re-inspection or compliance deadline.
14. Compile the report and store it according to local regulations or company policy.
15. Provide electronic copies to the building owner/manager and relevant authorities.
16
